observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an ASUS Z97-K motherboard with the model printed vertically near the PCIe slot.
Photo 1 shows the full board with an Intel-branded CPU cooler, four DDR3 slots, and Z97-K printed near the center.
Photo 2 is a duplicate angle of photo 1 showing the same ASUS Z97-K board.
Visible features include UEFI BIOS, CrossFireX Ready, M.2 Support, DirectX 11 Support, and SX PROTECTION.

claims.evidence: photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2 show ASUS Z97-K printed on the PCB
Z97-K is an Intel LGA1150 chipset motherboard for 4th/5th gen Core, visible in photos 0-2

risks.risk: Motherboard does not power on or POST
risks.proof: video of the board booting to BIOS with CPU, RAM, and display connected

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage such as bent CPU socket pins, cracked PCB, or swollen capacitors
risks.proof: close-up photos of the CPU socket, VRM heatsink area, and capacitor banks

risks.risk: BIOS password locked or missing I/O shield and accessories
risks.proof: photo of the BIOS screen and a photo of all included accessories

proof_requests: Video of the motherboard booting to BIOS with CPU, RAM, and monitor connected
Close-up photo of the CPU socket pins
Photo of all included accessories and I/O shield
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an ASUS Z97-K motherboard from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working) while awaiting proof of function.
